subject: the authority documents of the 2025 MSCA Doctoral Networks call and of the 2026 call the current profile was written for
purpose: Every document a matrix row may cite, pinned by sha256, with the era whose rules it states, the class of authority it is, and three separate answers about it: how its bytes are vouched for here, what says they are the issuing body's, and whether this was the version in force for the era it states rules for. A document this repository does not hold is an entry too, so a row cannot rest on one by assuming what it would say.
declared_status_note: Inferred, not Confirmed, and now for a narrower reason than before. Four documents record where their bytes came from, and three of those were retrieved from the issuing body's own published addresses and agree with a second, independent copy. That is evidence of origin, and it is not a hash published by the issuing body. No entry carries one, so byte integrity stays computed in this tree and no row rests a Confirmed status on it. The entries with no recorded origin at all are unchanged: for them nothing says the stored bytes are the official ones.
supersedes: the authority source index and equivalence matrix authored on 2026-10-12, `docs/tier4_orchestration_state/msca_dn/authority/authority_source_index_2026-10-12.json` (sha256 6a93702973a16f7daccea522c9a7543e129a3d4a170be6215b7265029bc4cae5) and `docs/tier4_orchestration_state/msca_dn/authority/equivalence_matrix_2025_2026-10-12.json` (sha256 115949d3fe4858340128a6ce1fc3afe83f28a085347714752ccf1ca9d9453bcd). Those two declared four 2025 documents absent. Three of them have since been obtained and the fourth is not a document this repository needs, so the entries and the rows resting on their absence are restated here. The superseded pair stays in the tree unedited: a correction to an index is a successor index, and the record of what was believed on 2026-10-12 is part of the evidence.
uncertainties: No entry is authenticated by a hash from its issuing body, so no matrix row may declare Confirmed and none does. Three documents are corroborated by a second independent copy, which is evidence of origin and not an issuer's hash.

The 2025 evaluation form's place in the call is bracketed and not closed. Three captures of its published address carry one digest, the last of them twenty days before the deadline, and a version served between captures and never captured would leave no trace. Row EI-02 keeps that open.
The 2025 application form has no recorded origin and no established place in the call. It was in this tree before any retrieval was made, and the five rows citing it are Inferred for that reason.
No separate 2025 call document is held, and none is needed: the work programme part pinned here carries the call's own conditions and topic text, and the rows about them cite its pages.
The submission's binding to a call identifier is declared, not evidenced. The one unobtained entry is the document that would settle it.
Four entries are tracked inputs: the scorecard, the 2026 profile, the appendix mapping and the specification. Any edit to one makes the matrix stale until it is re-derived.
authority_note: This index confers no authority. It records what is held and what is missing. Pinning a document is not authenticating it, retrieving one from its published address is not establishing what governed a closed call, and recording a destination for an absent document asserts nothing about a file there.
